stops.name: Parco regionale del Partenio
stops.detail: The regional park of Partenio is a protected natural area located in Campania established since 1993. It occupies an area of 16.650 ha on the Monti del Partenio, between the provinces of Avellino, Benevento, Caserta and Naples.
